equal-sign-skill-01.target: I can tell whether an equation is true or false by checking that both sides are the same amount.
equal-sign-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can tell whether an equation is true or false by checking that both sides are the same amount.
equal-sign-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Thinking the equal sign means “the answer comes next,” so 7 = 7 or 5 = 2 + 3 looks wrong. Try this: Read = as “is the same as” and build each side with cubes.

equal-sign-skill-02.target: I can find the unknown number in an addition or subtraction equation.
equal-sign-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find the unknown number in an addition or subtraction equation.
equal-sign-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Combining all numbers shown (8 + ___ = 11 → 19). Try this: Ask what number makes both sides the same; check by putting it in the blank.

equal-sign-skill-03.target: I can find a number that makes both sides of an equation the same, such as 6 + 4 = 5 + ___.
equal-sign-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find a number that makes both sides of an equation the same, such as 6 + 4 = 5 + ___.
equal-sign-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Writing the total of the first side in the blank (6 + 4 = 5 + 10). Try this: Find the amount on the side you know, then ask what the other side still needs.
